description.value: Seto Sushi is a Japanese takeout and delivery spot on Departure Bay Road in Nanaimo, known for large portions of fresh sushi, bento boxes, udon, poke bowls, and specialty rolls. The online-order model makes it a practical stop for cyclists wanting a quick, filling meal without a long dine-in wait.
